'''Mad Gass'kin''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who owned and operated [[Mad Gass'kin's Used DroidNet]]. He ran an advertisement for his services on the [[DroidNet]].<ref name="GC3" />

In his advertisement, he claimed that his agents would procure whatever [[Droid/Legends|droids]] the buyer would want, and deliver to the client, so to protect Gass'kin.<ref name="GC3" />

He also claimed that he was not "Mad", but that it was his actual name that happened to mean a certain way in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="GC3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mad Gass'kin's advertisement appears in the ''[[Look Sir, Droids!]]'' article in [[2001]]'s [[Star Wars Gamer 3|''Star Wars Gamer'' 3]].<ref name="GC3" />
